statBlock.name: Avatar of Nidhogg
statBlock.description: Nidhogg sends this wingless dragon of roots and clay in his place when a favored cultist needs his aid.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 23. Stealth 18. Immune to necrotic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Keensense 60 ft. Speaks Common, Draconic, and Void Speech.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +13 · DEX +2 · CON +11 · INT +5 · WIS +13 · CHA +10
sections.Traits:
Aura of Hopelessness. A hostile creature that begins its turn within 15 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, until its next turn starts, it rolls attacks with disadvantage and gains half as many HP from healing effects. The avatar can exempt any creature without spending an action.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The avatar can turn its failed save into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks, substituting a Tail attack for any of them.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 19) and stays Restrained until the grapple ends. The avatar can hold up to four Medium or smaller creatures or two Large creatures.
Decaying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 54 (12d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plant creatures and magical plants make this save with disadvantage. Use the maximum damage roll against them. Ordinary nonmagical plants in the cone die.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The avatar has three legendary actions per round. It chooses one option at the end of another creature’s turn and refreshes its pool at the start of its own.
Detect. Pinpoint every creature and trap within 30 ft. automatically.
Move. Move up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Void Wave (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and falls Prone. Void taint imposes disadvantage on the save. If a tainted creature fails, it takes another 4 (1d8) necrotic damage per level of void taint. The avatar heals HP equal to that extra damage, then the creature loses all levels of void taint.
sections.Encounter reference: Void taint measures exposure to the Void. Use the target’s current levels for Void Wave. See Chapter 7 for the optional taint rules.

name: Bone Knight
notes: The Black Flag undead remains separate from the Eberron Bone Knight.

statBlock.name: Bone Knight
statBlock.description: The disgraced soldier’s soul is bound into a carved bone head mounted on a suit of plate.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Plate armor. Perception 13. Stealth 8 in plate or 13 without it. Immune to necrotic and poison damage, exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +2 · INT +0 · WIS +1 · CHA +2
sections.Traits:
Disgraced Rejuvenation. If destroyed before it is redeemed, the knight revives at full HP in 1d4 days within 10 ft. of where it fell.
Necrotic Weapons. Add 2d6 necrotic damage to any weapon hit. The listed attacks already include it.
Undead Nature. The knight needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Undead Resilience. The knight ignores poison damage, exhaustion, and the Poisoned condition.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Bone Spur.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage either way.
Bone Spur. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target must make a DC 13 Constitution save or move at half speed through the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Guard. Friendly creatures within 5 ft. of the knight gain +2 AC while it holds this stance. The stance ends when its next turn starts, it dies, or it becomes Incapacitated.

statBlock.name: Dymaxion
statBlock.description: A living chariot that scoops allies off the battlefield and breathes holy fire.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 17. Stealth 14. Resistant to poison, psychic, radiant, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, plus Grappled, Poisoned, Prone, and Restrained. Immune to exhaustion. Keensense 30 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common and Celestial.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +6 · DEX +4 · CON +2 · INT +1 · WIS +7 · CHA +6
sections.Traits:
Celestial Resilience. Resists radiant damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
Immortal Nature. The dymaxion needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change the dymaxion’s form.
Living Chariot. Its 10-ft.-square carriage holds up to four Medium creatures or one Large creature. Riders have half cover from attacks and effects originating outside the dymaxion’s space, and advantage on checks and saves against forced movement. They can see out, act on their own initiative, share its space, and travel with it. A creature within 5 ft. can board an available spot by spending 5 ft. of movement. A rider can spend 5 ft. of movement to step into a free space within 5 ft. of the dymaxion. A rider exits automatically if forced movement takes it out of the dymaxion’s occupied spaces.
Magic Resistance. The dymaxion rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Spiked Wheel or Spit Holy Fire.
Spiked Wheel. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Spit Holy Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) fire and 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Holy Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Dexterity save. A failed save deals 17 (5d6) fire and 17 (5d6) radiant damage. A success halves both.
sections.Bonus Actions: Rallying Rush. Move up to 30 ft. in a straight line through the spaces of creatures no larger than Large. The first entry into each eligible enemy’s space forces a DC 15 Strength save. A failure pushes it up to 5 ft. away from the dymaxion. The first entry into each eligible ally’s space lets that ally spend its reaction to board if there is room. Opportunity attacks against the dymaxion during this move have disadvantage.

statBlock.name: Forge Servitor
statBlock.description: A repair automaton from the Cold Forge that wields a saw and a pneumatic nail gun.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 15. Stealth 11. Immune to poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands Dwarvish and has no speech.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +1 · INT -2 · WIS +1 · CHA -2
sections.Traits:
Construct Nature. The servitor needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Construct Resilience. The servitor ignores poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, and the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions.
Mechanic. The servitor and each ally within 5 ft. of it have advantage on ability checks using tools.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Saw or Pneumatic Nail. Repair can replace one attack.
Saw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Pneumatic Nail. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Repair. Another Construct or an object within 5 ft. regains 5 (2d4) HP, up to half its maximum HP.
sections.Bonus Actions: Spark Spray (19 HP or fewer). Creatures within 10 ft. make a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

name: Frost Knight
notes: Warhammer uses slashing damage in the printed stat block.

statBlock.name: Frost Knight
statBlock.description: A warrior who froze before completing its mission. Burning every piece of its remains can put it to rest.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Plate armor. Perception 14. Stealth 7 in plate or 12 without it. Resistant to cold and necrotic damage. Immune to poison damage, exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +2 · CON +4 · INT +0 · WIS +1 · CHA +3
sections.Traits:
Disgraced Rejuvenation. If destroyed before it is redeemed, the knight revives at full HP in 1d4 days within 10 ft. of where it fell.
Undead Nature. The knight needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Undead Resilience. The knight ignores poison damage, exhaustion, and the Poisoned condition.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Warhammer attacks or two Ice Splinter attacks.
Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing and 10 (3d6) cold damage.
Ice Splinter. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. The target and any creature within 5 ft. of it then make a DC 15 Dexterity save. A failure deals 10 (3d6) cold damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cold Stare. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, ice leaves it Restrained until the knight’s next turn starts or the target takes fire damage.

statBlock.name: Giant of the Falling Mountain
statBlock.description: A giant scholar of the Ancients who rides a bound skimmer and fights with recovered force weapons.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Scale mail. Perception 13. Stealth 12. Resistant to Stunned. Vulnerable to Prone. No special senses. Speaks Common, Giant, and Qoradan.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +2 · CON +7 · INT +4 · WIS +0 · CHA -1
sections.Traits:
Air Skimmer. A magic disk bound to the giant provides its fly speed. Treat the disk as part of its body. Individual targeting or separation requires the giant’s permission. The disk becomes ordinary metal on the giant’s death.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attacks.
Giant Attributes. The giant resists Stunned and is vulnerable to Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks or three Force Bolt attacks. A creature hit by both Morningstar attacks or by two Force Bolts can be pushed up to 10 ft. away from the giant.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing and 5 (1d10) force damage.
Force Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage.
Energy Lance (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft.-long, 10-ft.-wide line make a DC 15 Dexterity save against 27 (5d10) force damage, taking half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Air Skimmer. While separated from the bound disk, the giant can call it back by magic.
sections.Reactions: Arcane Fumes. After a creature moves into a space within 5 ft. of the giant or attacks it while within 5 ft., the skimmer can vent gas. Creatures within 5 ft. make a DC 15 Constitution save or are Poisoned through the end of their next turn.

name: Qoradan Tomb Guardian
notes: The printed Overdrive entry and exit thresholds are 46 HP or fewer and above 51 HP.

statBlock.name: Qoradan Tomb Guardian
statBlock.description: An orichalcum wheel with blades that races through the Ancients’ ruins to drive off intruders.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 16. Stealth 13. Resistant to acid, fire, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Keensense 120 ft. Understands the languages of the Ancients and Machine Speech and has no speech.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +3 · CON +4 · INT -3 · WIS +6 · CHA -3
sections.Traits:
Construct Nature. The guardian needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Construct Resilience. The guardian ignores poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, and the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions.
Wheelie Maneuverable. Moving out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attacks. The guardian can fit through spaces large enough for a Small or Medium creature without squeezing.
Overdrive (46 HP or fewer). Once it hits this threshold, the guardian gains advantage on melee weapon attacks and its attackers gain advantage against it. This lasts until it has more than 51 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Whirling Blade attacks or two Flame Jet attacks.
Whirling Blade. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.
Flame Jet. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 21 (4d8 + 3) fire damage.
Acid Spray (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Dexterity save against 31 (7d8) acid damage, taking half on a success.
sections.Reactions: Stunning Jolt. When a visible creature within 5 ft. hits the guardian with a melee attack, force it to make a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure the attacker is Stunned through the end of its next turn. Each time it takes damage while Stunned this way, it can repeat the save and end the effect on a success.

name: Sphinx, Tunnel
notes: The book lists both Monstrosity Resilience and explicit immunity to Frightened. The immunity applies.

statBlock.name: Sphinx, Tunnel
statBlock.description: A prophetic guardian of Labyrinth ruins and archives. It honors those who answer its riddles.
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 18. Stealth 12. Resistant to exhaustion. Immune to psychic damage, Charmed, and Frightened. Truesight 120 ft. Speaks Common, Qoradan, and Sphinx. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +8 · DEX +2 · CON +3 · INT +8 · WIS +8 · CHA +4
sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. Effects that sense emotion or read thoughts fail against the sphinx, as do divination spells it chooses to refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks about its intent or honesty have disadvantage.
Magical Claws. A Claw attack counts as magical and deals an extra 2d8 force damage on a hit, already included below.
Monstrosity Resilience. The sphinx resists exhaustion and has Frightened immunity under its listed defenses.
Truth Speaker. The sphinx must speak truthfully to anyone who solves one of its riddles or passes one of its tests.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Ram and two Claw attacks, or three Arcane Bolt attacks. Spellcasting can replace one of these attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Arcane Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 21 (5d6 + 4) force damage.
Spellcasting. Wisdom, save DC 16, no components. At will: detect magic, mage hand, minor illusion. 3/day each: dispel magic, divination (as an action), suggestion, tongues. 1/day each: banishment, geas (as an action).
sections.Bonus Actions: Dire Warning. One creature within 60 ft. that can hear the sphinx makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target is Frightened for 1 minute and has speed 0 while Frightened this way. A failure by 5 or more also leaves it Paralyzed for the same duration. It repeats the save at the end of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The sphinx has three legendary actions per round. It chooses one option at the end of another creature’s turn and refreshes its pool at the start of its own.
Teleport. Move magically up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space, taking worn and carried equipment along.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
Lacerating Swipe (2 actions). Creatures in a 15-ft. cone make a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failure deals 7 (2d6) slashing damage and opens a bleeding wound. The wound costs the target 3 (1d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. Magical healing closes it, as does an action with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Medicine) check by any creature.
